maker: Guangdong Bright Dream Robotics Co., Ltd. (Country Garden)
model: Wallpaper Hanging Robot (墙纸铺贴机器人)
name: Bright Dream wallpaper hanging robot
summary: Indoor robot that feeds, pastes, cuts and hangs wallpaper along a planned path, correcting its posture to keep strips plumb and joints tight. Made by Bright Dream in Foshan.

germany.statusNote: No route for a German buyer. Bright Dream lists the robot only on its Chinese website, whose product detail pages are blank, and its global exclusive agent BrightMaster Robotics (BMR) does not offer it. No EU dealer, customer or CE marking found.

specs.label: Functions
specs.value: feeding, pasting, cutting and hanging wallpaper
specs.quote: 机器人集墙纸输送、上胶、裁剪、铺贴等功能于一体

specs.label: Quality control
specs.value: multi-sensor posture control for plumb strips and joint accuracy
specs.quote: 保证墙纸铺贴的垂直度和拼接精度

notes: Moves along a planned path on its own (maker). Drive not described; wheels assumed.
Bright Dream says 28 of its robot types are in commercial use; this one is listed as a product, but it is not offered by BMR.

evidence.task: Hung wallpaper automatically along its planned path after a worker loaded the material
evidence.where: Country Garden Jinping project, Shantou, China
evidence.note: Part of the multi-robot fit-out system accepted on 30 December 2021.
